name: live_query_json
about: The unavailable-service path on a unary RPC: `loams.live.v1` is a `full`-variant engine, so every one of its RPCs answers `unimplemented` with reason `feature_not_in_variant` and the variant in `metadata`. (The proto3 JSON mapping, which is what `curl` sends (design §44 §4).)

body.message: loams.live.v1.LiveService/Query is not in the standard variant
